Lesson · 20 min

Proofreading, Printing, and Sending Documents

Finish a document the professional way: check spelling and grammar, use word count and find and replace, then print, download, email, or copy it.

By the end of this lesson you can

  • ✓Check spelling and grammar and fix or ignore each suggestion
  • ✓Use Word count and Find and replace
  • ✓Print a document or save it as a PDF from the Print box
  • ✓Email a document as an attachment and make a copy for a new purpose

Lesson Notes

Read through the key concepts before you try the challenge.

Proofread before anyone else reads it

On the job

You are sending the move-in letter to a new tenant at Elm Street Apartments.

The letter has a spelling mistake, it says Elm St. in some places and Elm Street in others, and it must be printed for the move-in packet and emailed to the tenant as a PDF. Denise also wants a copy to reuse for the next new tenant.

Your task: Proofread, print, and send the letter, and keep a reusable copy.

  • When spelling and grammar suggestions are on, Docs underlines misspelled words in red and grammar suggestions in blue. Right-click an underlined word and click the suggested word to accept it, or click Ignore.
  • To go through the whole document, click Spelling and grammar check on the toolbar (at the top left). A box opens at the top right: click Change to use a suggestion or Ignore to skip it. More › Accept all or Ignore all handles every suggestion at once.
  • Read it yourself too. A checker cannot tell that you typed the wrong apartment number.

Word count and Find and replace

  • Tools › Word count (Ctrl+Shift+C) shows pages, words, and characters. Check Display word count while typing to keep a count on screen.
  • Edit › Find and replace (Ctrl+H): type what to find and what to replace it with, then click Replace or Replace all. Check Match case when capital letters matter.
Drag and drop: put in order

Print, download, email, or copy

Before you email a document outside Parkview, check that it contains only what the reader should see. Delete comments and suggestions, or send a PDF, so internal notes do not go out with it.

Knowledge Check

Check your understanding

The letter says Elm St. in six places. You want them all to say Elm Street. What is fastest?

Check your understanding

You need next month's move-in letter to start from this one, without changing this one. What do you do?

Proofread and send the move-in letter

Challenge

Apply what you've learned in this lesson.

Finish a document in your own account.

  1. Open any practice document and click Spelling and grammar check on the toolbar. Change or ignore each suggestion.
  2. Use Edit › Find and replace to replace one word everywhere it appears.
  3. Open File › Print and choose Save as PDF as the Destination. Save the PDF.
  4. Use File › Make a copy to make a copy named Copy for Next Time.
Deliverable: Submit the PDF you saved to your instructor or course folder. No Google account? Complete the practice simulation and submit its results page.
